text: I understand you have provided a history of our dialogue, but it appears to be empty. Additionally, have you noticed any changes in the size of your supraclavicular lymph nodes?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Those are concerning systemic symptoms, especially the combination of night sweats, significant weight loss, and abdominal pain. Have you noticed any changes in the size or tenderness of your lymph nodes, particularly in the supraclavicular area? REQUEST TEST: CBC, LDH, ESR.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Complete_Blood_Count: WBC - Elevated, Hemoglobin - Slightly Decreased, Platelets - Normal; Lactate_Dehydrogenase - Elevated; ESR - Not Reported.

speaker: Doctor
text: The elevated white blood cell count, low hemoglobin, and high LDH are highly suggestive of a hematologic malignancy. Have you noticed any abnormal bleeding, bruising, or persistent fever in addition to the fatigue and sweats? REQUEST IMAGES: CT_Abdomen_Pelvis, CT_Chest.

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, B-symptoms (night sweats, weight loss), and elevated LDH is highly concerning for a malignancy. Have you noticed any painless lumps in your armpits or groin, and have you had any recent fevers? REQUEST TEST: LDH, Beta-2 Microglobulin. DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma
